points.point: Why a made-up ID returns in-progress instead of 404
points.sentence: If none matches, it returns in-progress. This fallback does not confirm a live queue job or validate a guessed submission ID.
In-progress can also mean Blotato found no record for that id, so it does not prove the post exists or failed.

verdict.reason: The in-progress entry says an unmatched or guessed ID returns in-progress as a fallback, so this is the endpoint's normal behavior and not a break.
